pairs: Factum est autem post hæc ut Absalom filii David sororem speciosissimam, vocabulo Thamar, adamaret Amnon filius David,
Now after these things, it happened that Amnon, the son of David, was in love with the very beautiful sister of Absalom, the son of David, and she was called Tamar.
And he pined for her exceedingly,
ita ut propter amorem ejus ægrotaret:
so much so that, out of love for her, he became ill.
For, since she was a virgin,
difficile ei videbatur ut quippiam inhoneste ageret cum ea.
it seemed a difficulty to him that he would do anything dishonest with her.
Erat autem Amnon amicus nomine Jonadab,
Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab,
the son of Shimeah, the brother of David:
“Why are you becoming so thin from day to day,
Thamar sororem fratris mei Absalom amo.
the sister of my brother Absalom.”
cumque venerit pater tuus ut visitet te,
And when your father will come to visit you,
‘I ask you to let my sister Tamar come to me,
so that she may give me food,
and may make a small meal,
so that I may eat it from her hand.’”
and he began to act as if he were ill.
cumque venisset rex ad visitandum eum,
And when the king had come to visit him,
“I beg you to let my sister Tamar come to me,
ut faciat in oculis meis duas sorbitiunculas,
and make in my sight two little portions of food,
et cibum capiam de manu ejus.
so that I take it from her hand.”
Misit ergo David ad Thamar domum,
Therefore, David sent home to Tamar,
Veni in domum Amnon fratris tui,
“Come to the house of your brother Amnon,
and make a small meal for him.”
Venitque Thamar in domum Amnon fratris sui:
And Tamar went into the house of her brother Amnon.
And taking flour, she mixed it.
et liquefaciens, in oculis ejus coxit sorbitiunculas.
And dissolving it in his sight, she cooked little portions of food.
And taking what she had cooked,
and she set it before him.
And when they had sent everyone away,
so that I may eat from your hand.”
Tulit ergo Thamar sorbitiunculas quas fecerat,
Therefore, Tamar took the little portions of food that she had made,
et intulit ad Amnon fratrem suum in conclave.
and she brought them to her brother Amnon in the bedroom.
And when she had presented the food to him,
my brother! Do not force me.
neque enim hoc fas est in Israël:
For no such thing must be done in Israel.
Do not choose to do this senseless act.
Ego enim ferre non potero opprobrium meum,
For I will not be able to bear my shame.
et tu eris quasi unus de insipientibus in Israël:
And you will be like one of the foolish in Israel.
For it is better to speak to the king,
and he will not deny me to you.”
But he was not willing to agree to her petition.
Instead, prevailing by strength, he forced her,
Et exosam eam habuit Amnon odio magno nimis:
And Amnon held hatred for her with an exceedingly great hatred,
ita ut majus esset odium quo oderat eam, amore quo ante dilexerat.
so much so that the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her before.
Majus est hoc malum quod nunc agis adversum me,
which you are now doing against me in driving me away,
But he was not willing to listen to her.
sed vocato puero qui ministrabat ei,
Instead, calling the servants who were ministering to him,
and close the door behind her.”
Now she was clothed with an ankle-length robe.
hujuscemodi enim filiæ regis virgines vestibus utebantur.
For the virgin daughters of the king made use of this kind of garment.
Ejecit itaque eam minister illius foras:
And so, his servant cast her out,
and he closed the door behind her.
And she sprinkled ashes upon her head,
and she tore her ankle-length robe.
And placing her hands upon her head,
Dixit autem ei Absalom frater suus:
Then her brother Absalom said to her:
Numquid Amnon frater tuus concubuit tecum?
“Has your brother Amnon lain with you? But now,
neque affligas cor tuum pro hac re.
And you should not afflict your heart because of this matter.”
Mansit itaque Thamar contabescens in domo Absalom fratris sui.
And so, Tamar remained, wasting away in the house of her brother Absalom.
Cum autem audisset rex David verba hæc,
And when king David had heard about these things,
et noluit contristare spiritum Amnon filii sui,
But he was not willing to afflict the spirit of his son Amnon.
Porro non est locutus Absalom ad Amnon nec malum nec bonum:
Yet Absalom did not speak to Amnon,
eo quod violasset Thamar sororem suam.
For Absalom hated Amnon because he had violated his sister Tamar.
Factum est autem post tempus biennii ut tonderentur oves Absalom in Baalhasor,
Then, after the time of two years, it happened that the sheep of Absalom were being shorn in Baal-hazor,
et vocavit Absalom omnes filios regis,
And Absalom invited all the sons of the king.
And he went to the king,
“Behold, the sheep of your servant are being shorn.
rex cum servis suis ad servum suum.
with his servants, may come to his servant.”
And the king said to Absalom:
noli rogare ut veniamus omnes et gravemus te.
do not choose to ask that we may all come and be a burden to you.”
and he had refused to go,
“If you are not willing to come,
at least let my brother Amnon come with us.”
And the king said to him,
Non est necesse ut vadat tecum.
“It is not necessary that he go with you.”
and so he sent with him Amnon and all the sons of the king.
Feceratque Absalom convivium quasi convivium regis.
like the feast of a king.
Observate cum temulentus fuerit Amnon vino,
“Observe when Amnon will have become drunk with wine.
And when I say to you,
ego enim sum qui præcipio vobis:
For it is I who commands you.
Fecerunt ergo pueri Absalom adversum Amnon sicut præceperat eis Absalom.
Therefore, the servants of Absalom acted against Amnon, just as Absalom had commanded them.
Surgentesque omnes filii regis ascenderunt singuli mulas suas, et fugerunt.
And all the sons of the king rose up, and each one climbed upon his mule and fled.
And while they were still traveling on the journey,
“Absalom has struck down all the sons of the king,
et non remansit ex eis saltem unus.
and there is not one of them remaining.”
And so the king rose up,
and he fell upon the ground.
et omnes servi illius qui assistebant ei,
And all his servants, who were standing near him,
Respondens autem Jonadab filius Semmaa fratris David,
But Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David’s brother,
Ne æstimet dominus meus rex quod omnes pueri filii regis occisi sint:
said: “My lord the king should not consider that all the sons of the king have been slain.
quoniam in ore Absalom erat positus ex die qua oppressit Thamar sororem ejus.
For he was set against by the mouth of Absalom from the day that he raped his sister Tamar.
Nunc ergo ne ponat dominus meus rex super cor suum verbum istud,
Now therefore, let not my lord the king set this word in his heart,
Omnes filii regis occisi sunt: quoniam Amnon solus mortuus est.
‘All the sons of the king have been slain.’ For only Amnon is dead.”
Et elevavit puer speculator oculos suos, et aspexit:
And the young man keeping watch, lifted up his eyes and gazed out.
et ecce populus multus veniebat per iter devium ex latere montis.
And behold, many people were arriving along a remote road at the side of the mountain.
And Jonadab said to the king: “Behold,
the sons of the king are here.
In accord with the word of your servant,
And when he had ceased speaking,
the sons of the king also appeared.
et omnes servi ejus fleverunt ploratu magno nimis.
wept with an exceedingly great weeping.
Porro Absalom fugiens abiit ad Tholomai filium Ammiud regem Gessur. Luxit ergo David filium suum cunctis diebus.
But Absalom, fleeing, went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. Then David mourned for his son every day.
Now after he had fled and had arrived in Geshur, Absalom was in that place for three years.
And king David ceased to pursue Absalom,
because he had been consoled over the passing of Amnon.
Cessavitque rex David persequi Absalom, eo quod consolatus esset super Amnon interitu.
